reason: My office does the phone and I already have more work than my people can handle, so a few missed callers are not my problem. Maybe I'd let them run the free count, but I wouldn't pay 99 euros a month to catch jobs I can't take anyway.
objection: I don't need more calls, I need more hands. And I'm not letting a brand-new two-man firm with no customers stand between my regulars and my phone.
would_change_my_mind: If the free check showed my office is losing well-paid jobs or regular customers in large numbers, and the 'ausgebucht' mode really shielded us from the time-wasters.
